authority: Approved Survival Paradise male/female side-profile art + user-rejected 4x APK screenshots + fresh runtime captures
notes: Shoulders must originate near the visible outer deltoid, not chest center.
Hands must read as hands at gameplay scale and remain proportionate to forearms.
Weapons must retain distinct stock/receiver/handguard/barrel or slide/grip mass.
This numeric contract is a regression floor; final acceptance still requires human visual comparison against the approved reference sheets.
Visual-fix-v2 second gate: shoulder sockets must sit higher/outboard at the deltoid; runtime weapon draw height must remain reference-like rather than blocky.
Hand bounds were recalibrated after the first v2 runtime pass: generated grip art now occupies most of its canvas, so previous 8–9 unit draw boxes produced oversized open hands.
Visual-fix-v2 shoulder bridge: full armed upper arms remain behind torso; only a short textured proximal cap is redrawn to make the deltoid attachment visible.

V2 grip calibration: rifle stock is visible at the shoulder, weapon art sockets and IK wrist targets share the same geometry, and visible hand occupancy is enlarged to match the approved grip reference.
Arm mass recalibrated after magnified runtime review: preserve detailed texture and taper while avoiding the oversized forearm/shoulder blobs seen in the prior V2 pass.
Final shoulder rule: no artificial foreground cap. Canonical upper arms remain behind torso and must emerge naturally from outboard deltoid sockets.
Hybrid V3 replaces V2's center-stretched segment rectangles with tight +X sprites rotated about explicit parent pivots and uniformly scaled only from canonical bone length.
Hybrid V3 restores a compact textured shoulder cap as an intentional deltoid bridge; this is not a full upper-arm redraw and must remain anchored to the canonical shoulder socket.
Hybrid V3 armed-hand refinement: locked IK grip sockets now land inside the rendered palm; free-hand wrist anchoring is unchanged.
Hybrid V3 pistol scale recalibrated from runtime evidence so sidearm length is realistic relative to the 10.5–10.7 unit forearm while preserving the exact locked grip socket.
Hybrid V3 final shoulder composition: compact deltoid caps are rendered behind the torso so torso occlusion hides their root and prevents a pasted-on shoulder-pad silhouette.
Universal-rig refinement: armed poses use one continuous shoulder→elbow→wrist ribbon after torso composition; authored modular upper/forearm sprites are suppressed for armed silhouettes.

Rifle side-view depth rule: the solved dominant arm may be fully occluded by torso/stock until the firing hand emerges at the trigger; this prevents artificial X/triangle construction without changing IK.
Body-relative recalibration after user-rejected 4x APK: old +X shoulder sockets were on the front chest; accepted shoulder region is posterior to torso center in side view.
Arm silhouette width and hand draw scale must come from the sex profile values; hardcoded undersized ribbon/hand constants are prohibited.
The old 1928/1928 geometry sweep remains necessary but is not sufficient; body-relative torso/arm/hand ratio checks are mandatory.
Visual acceptance requires direct comparison of the newest Godot captures against the approved male/female character art, including gear-off and gear-on.
Grip-contact correction: the weapon contact and anatomical wrist are distinct points. IK terminates at the wrist; the authored palm spans from wrist to grip.
Armed hand sprites must be wrist-anchored. Reintroducing grip-centered hand pivots would make the forearm terminate inside the palm and visually twist the hand.

Direct reference-vs-runtime recalibration: tight closed grip masks require smaller world extents than the former open-hand sprites; hand/forearm ratios are shifted downward while remaining substantially larger and more readable than the rejected pre-recalibration 3px-class hands.
Hand material rule: connected weapon-wrap alpha masks must be filled with authored glove/hand luminance detail; flat procedural RGB hands are not visually acceptable.
